research_question: How reliably do three LLMs localize the 38 frozen ArkTS defects compared with HomeCheck on the same controlled 18-file benchmark?
null_hypothesis: LLM-only exact defect-level recall does not differ materially across the three frozen model conditions and does not exhibit a multi-defect localization deficit.
alternative_hypothesis: LLM-only exact defect-level recall varies by model and is lower on multi-defect files, supporting deterministic analyzer localization as a repair prerequisite.

benchmark.scope: positive-enriched controlled benchmark; primary inference is recall over the 38 positives

generation.input: one complete ArkTS file plus the same frozen list of eight rule IDs
generation.output: JSON object with a defects array of rule and 1-based line
generation.thinking_disabled_probe: All three frozen model routes accepted reasoning_effort=none; the DeepSeek probe returned no reasoning_content and no reasoning_tokens.

evaluation.parse_failure_policy: Count the file as producing no valid predictions; preserve the raw response and count all GT defects in that file as false negatives.
evaluation.reporting_boundary: Precision and F1 are conditional on the selected 18 files and eight-rule closed set; real-project recall remains unknown.

execution_order: validate frozen hashes and source manifest
run one non-formal smoke file per model
